brief:
An Israeli official said Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has not excluded the possibility of launching an attack against Iran, Ma'an news agency reported. The statement comes as tensions between Israel and Iran remain elevated following recent regional escalations.

Details of the potential strike scenario were not specified. Netanyahu's position reflects ongoing Israeli security assessments regarding Iranian military capabilities and regional threats.

media.credit: Benjamin Netanyahu — Wikimedia Commons / US State Department (public domain)

title: Netanyahu does not rule out strike on Iran, Israeli official says
